name: Cable Incline Fly
steps: Set an adjustable bench to a moderate incline centered between two low pulleys.
Lie back with feet planted and hold both handles above your upper chest with softly bent elbows.
Open your arms in wide arcs until your upper arms come level with your torso.
Sweep your hands back together above your upper chest, squeezing your chest at the top.
tips: Keep the same bend in your elbows so the fly stays a wide arc.
Keep your shoulder blades resting against the pad rather than rolling your shoulders forward.
